questions.q: This number line goes from 0 to 2 and is cut into 8 equal parts. What decimal is point A? [img:ext-q1]
questions.why: Each part is 2 ÷ 8 = 0.25. A is on the 3rd mark: 3 × 0.25 = 0.75.

questions.q: Point B is halfway between two tenths marks on this line from 3 to 4. What is B? [img:ext-q2]
questions.why: B is halfway between 3.7 and 3.8, so it is 3.75.

questions.q: Point C is exactly halfway on a 0 to 1 line cut into fourths. Which is NOT another name for C? [img:ext-q3]
questions.why: C is on the 2nd fourth: 2/4 = 1/2 = 0.5. 1/4 is a different point.

questions.q: Which is closest to 1 on a number line?
questions.why: 0.95 is only 0.05 away from 1. The others are farther left.

questions.q: Put in order from least to greatest: 0.4, 0.04, 0.44, 0.404
A number line is cut into 5 equal jumps from 6 to 7. What is the fourth mark after 6?
questions.why: Each jump is 0.2. The 4th mark is 6 + 4 × 0.2 = 6.8.
